original_description:
NameReef Domain Generator finds domain names for your project that no one has registered yet.

Tell ChatGPT what you're starting, in your own words: what it is, where it is, the language, the tone, the length and the extensions you'd like. NameReef's AI thinks it through, invents names that fit and checks each one against registry data, so only names that registry data shows as unregistered come back, each with a one-sentence reason it fits. Finds arrive while the search runs, and you can steer it with follow-ups such as "10 more", "shorter" or "only .io".

What you can do:
• Generate domain names from a plain-language brief, for many extensions and languages
• Check names you already have in mind, up to 50 at a time
• See a finished search's names as cards, with every extension each one is free on
• Keep every search in your NameReef account, pick it up again later and sort your searches into projects
• Shortlist the names you like, grouped by project
• Spot premium names, which cost more than the standard registration fee

Who it's for: anyone naming a business, product, app, project or event who wants a name whose domain is still available.

Good to know: NameReef does not register or sell domains, so register a name you like with any registrar. Availability reflects registry data at the time of the check, so confirm with a registrar before you buy. A NameReef account is required, and searches use the account's weekly allowance. Names, reasons and briefs are written by AI.
